result.summary: Implements BIP 95 (Testnet 5) by adding the chain parameters and configuration for the new network. It removes the 20-minute minimum-difficulty exception found in Testnet 4, increases base difficulty, and activates BIP 54 (Consensus Cleanup) starting at block 1. The PR is stacked on top of unmerged BIP 54 support (#35793).
result.problem: Testnet 3 and 4 suffer from hash rate manipulation and block storms caused by the 20-minute minimum-difficulty rule, making them unreliable for application and protocol testing. Testnet 5 provides a stable public test network with higher minimum difficulty and modern consensus rules enforced from genesis.

result.card: Implements BIP 95 by defining Testnet 5 chain parameters and activating BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules from block 1. Testnet 5 eliminates the 20-minute minimum-difficulty exception and raises base difficulty to fix the block storm and timewarp manipulation issues that destabilized Testnet 4. The PR is stacked on unmerged BIP 54 support (#35793), has merge conflicts and failing CI, has received no reviews yet, and still requires a mined genesis block.
